---
title: "Create a container"
---

A container file is present within the repository of Delft-FIAT. This container file can
be found [here](https://github.com/Deltares/Delft-FIAT/blob/master/Containerfile).

::: {.callout-important}
We recommend using [podman](https://podman.io/) (alternative to docker), the cli calls reflect this.
:::

From this container file an image can be produced. In the creation process of the
image, pixi is used. [Pixi](https://pixi.sh/latest/) is a fast(er) alternative of creating and
installing python environments compared to mamba (conda). Creating a image can
be done with the following command:

::: {.callout-important}
The OS running used in the container will be [Fedora](https://fedoraproject.org/).
:::

::: {.callout-note}
Note: Set the current directory to the directory of the cloned repository.
:::

```bash
podman build -f Containerfile --build-arg="PIXIENV=default" -t fiat .
```

However, as an alternative, it can be build directly from the container file in the github
remote repository:

```bash
podman build -f https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Deltares/Delft-FIAT/master/Containerfile --build-arg="PIXIENV=default" -t fiat .
```

::: {.callout-tip}
The build argument `PIXIENV` is used to define which python enviroment to use. Using the `default` environment is recommended.
An overview of all the environments can be found in the [pixi toml file](https://github.com/Deltares/Delft-FIAT/blob/master/pixi.toml).
:::

After setting up the image, a podman container can be spawned from this
image. The podman container will contain all the necessary components to run
Delft-FIAT.

To run/ start a podman container from the previously created image:

::: {.callout-tip}
The `-v` argument sets a mount, i.e. connection from a directory on the host machine to the podman container.
:::

```bash
podman run -it  -v $PWD/data:/home/deltares/data --name fiat fiat:latest bash
```

When inside the podman container one can simply call FIAT:

```bash
fiat run --help
```
